// 27-tap direct-form FIR, 8-bit samples, unpipelined MAC cone (the long
// register-to-register path -> lower Fmax; pipeline it to go faster).
module firr27_v3 (
    input  wire        clk,
    input  wire        rst_n,
    input  wire [7:0]  x,
    output reg  [15:0] y
);
    reg  [7:0]  xs [0:26];
    integer     i;
    reg  [23:0] acc;
    always @(*) acc = 8'd5 +
               (8'd10 * xs[0]) +
               (8'd15 * xs[1]) +
               (8'd20 * xs[2]) +
               (8'd25 * xs[3]) +
               (8'd30 * xs[4]) +
               (8'd35 * xs[5]) +
               (8'd40 * xs[6]) +
               (8'd45 * xs[7]) +
               (8'd50 * xs[8]) +
               (8'd55 * xs[9]) +
               (8'd60 * xs[10]) +
               (8'd65 * xs[11]) +
               (8'd70 * xs[12]) +
               (8'd75 * xs[13]) +
               (8'd80 * xs[14]) +
               (8'd85 * xs[15]) +
               (8'd90 * xs[16]) +
               (8'd95 * xs[17]) +
               (8'd100 * xs[18]) +
               (8'd105 * xs[19]) +
               (8'd110 * xs[20]) +
               (8'd115 * xs[21]) +
               (8'd120 * xs[22]) +
               (8'd125 * xs[23]) +
               (8'd130 * xs[24]) +
               (8'd135 * xs[25]) +
               (8'd140 * xs[26]);
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            for (i = 0; i < 27; i = i + 1) xs[i] <= 8'd0;
            y <= 16'd0;
        end else begin
            xs[0] <= x;
            for (i = 1; i < 27; i = i + 1) xs[i] <= xs[i-1];
            y <= acc[15:0];
        end
    end
endmodule
